summary: The C1 fix's comment rewrite dropped the original INVARIANT paragraph (security-guardian, #2703) warning that this scoping is safe only because no default grant has yet landed on an existing (role,type) pair via a brand-new operation -- the exact scenario the C1 fix's own bug (ApiToken:Rotate) instantiated -- without restating an equivalent warning for the narrowed 3-dimension case.
classification_rationale: Diffed f392a3356 against its parent; confirmed the paragraph was present pre-fix and absent post-fix, with no replacement covering the residual case.

trigger: an on-call engineer diagnosing a fired rbac_enabled_non_canonical degrade for the row-absent sub-case searches the log for a bad VALUE and finds none, since none was read
summary: The shared WARN log text 'read a non-canonical value' fires unconditionally for both the pre-existing non-canonical-value case and the new row-absent case, and is factually wrong for the latter -- found independently by both consistency-auditor and cpp-expert.
classification_rationale: Read the call site directly; the row-absent branch never executes a codepath that reads a value.

trigger: n/a -- comment-vs-code drift only, no concurrency hazard (fire_non_canonical_degrade is a function-local bool, not shared state)
summary: The comment above fire_non_canonical_degrade's declaration claims all degrade decisions are 'decided as plain bools first' (before cache_mtx_ is taken), but the row-absent case (fjarvis MEDIUM fix) sets this same flag from inside the lock's durable_gen-confirmed branch.
classification_rationale: Confirmed the row-absent write happens inside the lock_guard scope; confirmed via direct read that durable_gen/durable_enabled/saw_non_canonical_enabled are all resolved before the lock, so the placement is a deliberate ordering choice (must only fire when durable_gen was also confirmed this round) rather than a mechanical necessity -- restructuring to match the comment would risk double-firing the degrade metric on a total refresh failure, so the comment was qualified instead of the code changed.

trigger: the new MEDIUM-fix regression test runs on a contended self-hosted runner (Big Tam / Wee Tam share 4 runner agents per box)
summary: New row-absent regression test (fjarvis MEDIUM fix) failed 1 of 6 local runs -- three assertions (degrade counter, rbac_enabled_view_degraded(), rbac_enforcement_in_effect()) all read as 'never happened' together. 5 subsequent runs incl. a full-suite run were clean. Reporting agent's own epistemic status: mechanism unconfirmed -- three assertions failing together doesn't obviously fit ordinary sleep-margin jitter, but no stress/load repro was run to confirm.
classification_rationale: Directly observed the one failing run's assertion output; could not reproduce a second time locally to isolate the mechanism.
adjudication_rationale: Underlying product fix (f392a3356) independently verified correct via direct code read, param-order tracing, and 5/6 clean runs of this exact test plus a clean full-suite + TSan run -- this is a test-reliability question, not a product defect, and the mechanism needs investigation (stress run) before a fix is chosen rather than guessed at.

summary: Second bounded, scoped Gate 8 governance round (security-guardian, cpp-safety, cpp-expert, consistency-auditor -- not the full 16-agent sweep) on f392a3356, the fold-in of fjarvis's second re-review (C1 HIGH blocker: revoked-permission cleanup's 2D role+type filter silently deleted and permanently suppressed newly-merged ApiToken:Rotate grants on every upgrade from a pre-Rotate legacy catalogue, reproduced against live Postgres; plus a non-blocking MEDIUM: the freshness clock advanced on refresh rounds that read write_generation but never confirmed rbac_enabled, specifically the row-absent sub-case). Zero BLOCKING findings from any of the 4 agents -- cpp-safety reported entirely clean (informational-level only, all 6 review questions independently verified against source history); the other three surfaced 5 non-blocking items, 4 folded in as commit d35bd8707 (security-guardian's dropped INVARIANT restored for the narrowed 3-dimension residual risk; two now-stale docs corrected; a shared WARN log message broadened to cover the row-absent sub-case, found independently by both consistency-auditor and cpp-expert; a comment qualified rather than working code restructured to fit it). One item (cpp-expert: a single local test flake, 1/6 runs, mechanism unconfirmed by the reporting agent itself) filed as issue #3036 for investigation rather than guessed at, since the fix it would guard is independently verified correct by other means. Full [rbac_store]/[list_read]/[lexical]/[rbac] suite green (2586 assertions, 158 cases) + 0 TSan warnings on [rbac_store] after the fold-in commit. Nothing pushed; push remains gated on operator approval per standing rule.
